dedupe_keys.name: ricon river and reservoir connectivity toolkit

description: The RICON toolkit is a separate Figshare software deposit for constructing a river and infrastructure connectivity network from streamgage, dam and river-flowline inputs. Its article demonstrates the method in the Colorado River Basin, where the derived edge and node tables expose upstream and downstream dependencies. A water-system modeller could adapt the toolkit to prepare topology for reservoir-operation, flow-alteration or cascade studies. The item is a source archive, not a hosted model, and its accuracy depends on the coverage and identifier matching of the supplied NHDPlus and infrastructure inventories. Figshare states MIT for this software item. I read the own repository metadata and article description without downloading or running the archive. The related published RICON network data are reviewed as another G1 item; no existing catalogue software record covers the toolkit. The earlier title-based rejection did not inspect the code deposit. A limitation is that the published demonstration covers one basin and cannot establish hydraulic behaviour elsewhere. The output can be used in network-flow simulation after local topology checks.
